aarti.tek: Om, victory, victory, victory to you, Girirāja, king of mountains; Master, victory, victory, victory to you, Girirāja. In times of trouble you keep the honour of your devotees.
aarti.pad1: Indra and all the gods together meditate on you. Seers and sages sing your glory, and they cross the ocean of worldly existence. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Your beautiful form shines as the dark stone. As the devotees gaze again and again at the forests and groves, their hearts are charmed. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: In your midst is Mānasī Gaṅgā, who takes away the impurities of the Kali age. Those who light lamps at her cross the Vaitaraṇī, the river of the dead. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: The Navala and Apsarā pools are lovely, purifying and joy-giving. On the left is Rādhā Kuṇḍa, where people bathe; it takes away even great sins. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: You alone are the giver of liberation and the master of the Kali age. Lord, you are the protector of the humble and the indweller of all. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Great mountain, Giridhārī, we are in your refuge. Son of Devakī, who do good to your devotees, have mercy. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Those who walk the parikramā, worship and recite, and sing the āratī every day, are not born again. ॥7॥
